title: $β$-$n$-sensitivity and other stronger forms of sensitivity in dynamical systems
summary: In this paper, we investigate the relationships between the $β$-$n$-sensitivity and other forms of sensitivity in discrete dynamical systems. And we present some different sufficient conditions (equivalent condition) to be (strongly) $β$-$n$-sensitive. These results improve and extend some existing ones. Moreover, we introduce and study the semi-strong $β$-$n$-sensitivity and (strong) multi-$β$-$n$-sensitivity with respect to $α$.
